fields.desc_en: The ideas under soma design: the body-mind as one living whole, felt from within, and the philosophy of cultivating it.
fields.desc_zh: 身体设计背后的思想：身与心是一个从内部被感受的整体，以及修养这个整体的哲学。

subs.desc_en: Shusterman's discipline of the body as the site of sensory appreciation and self-cultivation.
subs.desc_zh: Shusterman 提出的身体美学：身体是感官鉴赏与自我修养的所在。

subs.desc_en: Leib, flesh, felt sense, the absent body: Husserl, Merleau-Ponty, Sheets-Johnstone, Gendlin, Leder.
subs.desc_zh: 活的身体、肉身、体会、缺席的身体：Husserl、Merleau-Ponty、Sheets-Johnstone、Gendlin、Leder。

subs.desc_en: Mind as lived, embodied action: Varela, Thompson, Rosch, Johnson, Lakoff, Noë, Damasio.
subs.desc_zh: 心智是活出来的具身行动：Varela、Thompson、Rosch、Johnson、Lakoff、Noë、Damasio。

subs.en: Body-Mind Oneness in East Asian Thought
subs.zh: 东亚思想中的身心一如
subs.desc_en: Shinjin ichinyo, qi and self-cultivation: Yuasa Yasuo, Ichikawa Hiroshi, Zen, Daoist and Confucian body thought.
subs.desc_zh: 身心一如、气与修身：汤浅泰雄、市川浩、禅宗、道家与儒家的身体思想。

subs.desc_en: How HCI turned to the body: Dourish, Klemmer, Hornecker, Loke & Robertson, Höök's somaesthetic interaction design.
subs.desc_zh: 人机交互如何转向身体：Dourish、Klemmer、Hornecker、Loke & Robertson、Höök 的身体美学交互设计。

fields.desc_en: The practices soma designers train in and borrow from: movement education, meditation, breath, martial and dance traditions that treat body and mind as one.
fields.desc_zh: 身体设计师修习并借鉴的实践：动作教育、冥想、呼吸，以及把身心视为一体的武术与舞蹈传统。

subs.desc_en: Feldenkrais, Alexander Technique, Body-Mind Centering, Laban/Bartenieff, Hanna Somatics.
subs.desc_zh: Feldenkrais、亚历山大技巧、身心平衡技法（BMC）、Laban/Bartenieff、Hanna 身心学。

subs.desc_en: Practices of body-mind unity from Asia: qigong, tai chi, yoga, zazen, aikido, butoh roots.
subs.desc_zh: 来自亚洲的身心合一修习：气功、太极、瑜伽、坐禅、合气道等。

subs.desc_en: Mindfulness, body scan, breathwork and contemplative practice.
subs.desc_zh: 正念、身体扫描、呼吸练习与沉思修习。

subs.desc_en: Contact Improvisation, Authentic Movement, Continuum, Halprin, Butoh, Deborah Hay.
subs.desc_zh: 接触即兴、真实动作、Continuum、Halprin、舞踏、Deborah Hay。

subs.desc_en: Focusing, Somatic Experiencing, Hakomi and body-based approaches to trauma and pain.
subs.desc_zh: Focusing（体会聚焦）、身体经验疗法（SE）、Hakomi，以及以身体为本的创伤与疼痛疗法。

fields.desc_en: How to design from the body: first-person inquiry, estrangement, somatic training of the designer, bodystorming, material exploration, articulating felt experience.
fields.desc_zh: 如何从身体出发做设计：第一人称探究、陌生化、设计师的身体训练、身体风暴、材料探索、说出被感受到的经验。

subs.zh: 第一人称与自传式方法
subs.desc_en: The designer's own felt experience as data: first-person research, autoethnography, autobiographical design.
subs.desc_zh: 把设计师自身的感受当作数据：第一人称研究、自我民族志、自传式设计。

subs.desc_en: Disrupting habitual movement and perception to notice the body anew.
subs.desc_zh: 打破惯常的动作与感知，重新注意到身体。

subs.desc_en: Feldenkrais lessons, body scans and movement practice to sharpen the designer's sensitivity (somaesthetic appreciation).
subs.desc_zh: 用 Feldenkrais 课、身体扫描和动作练习，磨练设计师的感受力（身体美学鉴赏）。

subs.desc_en: Ideating with and through moving bodies, props and play.
subs.desc_zh: 借由运动的身体、道具与游戏来构思。

subs.desc_en: Feeling materials, actuators and biosignals on the body: Soma Bits, somaesthetic toolkits, somadata.
subs.desc_zh: 在身体上感受材料、执行器与生物信号：Soma Bits、身体美学工具包、somadata。

subs.zh: 说出并评估被感受到的经验
subs.desc_en: Micro-phenomenology, body maps, soma trajectories, the Sensual Evaluation Instrument, somatic connoisseurship.
subs.desc_zh: 微观现象学、身体地图、身体轨迹、感官评估工具、身体鉴赏力。

subs.zh: 强概念、设计品质与伦理
subs.desc_en: Intermediate-level design knowledge from soma design: strong concepts, design qualities, felt ethics.
subs.desc_zh: 从身体设计中提炼的中间层设计知识：强概念、设计品质、被感受的伦理。

fields.desc_en: Interactive systems that help us feel our own body-mind more richly: soma mats, breathing lights, heat, shape-change, sound and garments.
fields.desc_zh: 帮助我们更丰富地感受自身身心的交互系统：身体垫、呼吸灯、热、形变、声音与衣物。

subs.desc_en: Systems that slow us down and direct attention inward: Soma Mat, Breathing Light, guided body scans.
subs.desc_zh: 让我们慢下来、把注意力转向身体内部的系统：Soma Mat、Breathing Light、引导式身体扫描。

subs.desc_en: Breath as input, output and shared rhythm.
subs.desc_zh: 把呼吸当作输入、输出与共享的节律。

subs.desc_en: Technology that acts on the skin and body: heat, vibration, inflatables, shape-changing surfaces.
subs.desc_zh: 作用于皮肤与身体的技术：热、振动、充气结构、形变表面。

subs.desc_en: Hearing the body: movement sonification, singing, the voice as felt.
subs.desc_zh: 听见身体：动作声音化、歌唱、被感受到的嗓音。

subs.zh: 衣物、织物与柔性可穿戴
subs.desc_en: Clothing and soft materials that sense and touch: corsets, shirts, e-textiles.
subs.desc_zh: 能感知与触碰的衣物和柔软材料：胸衣、衬衫、电子织物。

fields.desc_en: Technology that extends the felt body: extra limbs, new senses, muscles moved by computers, cyborg art, and the transhuman and posthuman ideas behind them, read from the soma rather than from the machine.
fields.desc_zh: 延展被感受的身体的技术：多出来的肢体、新的感官、由计算机驱动的肌肉、赛博格艺术，以及其背后的超人类与后人类思想——从身体出发，而不是从机器出发来理解。

subs.zh: 多出来的肢体、尾巴与假体
subs.desc_en: Supernumerary fingers, arms and tails, and prostheses that the body learns to feel as its own.
subs.desc_zh: 多出来的手指、手臂和尾巴，以及身体学会视为己有的假体。

subs.desc_en: Feeling north, sound, infrared, echolocation or other species' senses through the skin and body.
subs.desc_zh: 借由皮肤与身体感受方向、声音、红外、回声定位或其他物种的感官。

subs.desc_en: Computers that move muscles, balance and reflexes (EMS, GVS): who is acting when the body is shared with a machine.
subs.desc_zh: 驱动肌肉、平衡与反射的计算机（肌肉电刺激、前庭电刺激）：当身体与机器共享时，是谁在行动。

subs.zh: 超人体育、增强游戏与表演
subs.desc_en: Play, sport, performance and rituals with augmented, AI-read or shared bodies.
subs.desc_zh: 以增强的、被 AI 读取的或共享的身体进行游戏、体育、表演与仪式。

subs.desc_en: Artists who rebuild their own bodies with technology: Stelarc, Harbisson, Ribas, Orlan, Donnarumma.
subs.desc_zh: 用技术重建自己身体的艺术家：Stelarc、Harbisson、Ribas、Orlan、Donnarumma。

subs.desc_en: From natural-born cyborgs and the cyborg manifesto to transhumanism and its critics: what augmentation means for body-mind unity.
subs.desc_zh: 从“天生的赛博格”与赛博格宣言，到超人类主义及其批评：增强对身心一体意味着什么。

fields.desc_en: Emotion as a bodily, felt process: affective loops, biosignals as design material, interoception, and the ambiguity of body data.
fields.desc_zh: 情绪是身体的、被感受的过程：情感回路、作为设计材料的生物信号、内感受，以及身体数据的模糊性。

subs.desc_en: Systems where emotion is co-produced through gesture and response: eMoto, Affective Diary, SenToy.
subs.desc_zh: 情绪在手势与回应中被共同产生的系统：eMoto、Affective Diary、SenToy。

subs.zh: 作为设计材料的生物信号
subs.desc_en: EDA, heart rate, EMG, EEG turned into felt experience: from biodata to somadata.
subs.desc_zh: 把皮肤电、心率、肌电、脑电转化为可感受的体验：从生物数据到身体数据。

subs.desc_en: Heartbeat, gut, breath and inner sensations made perceptible or altered.
subs.desc_zh: 让心跳、肠胃、呼吸等内在感觉变得可感知或被改变。

subs.zh: 身体数据、反思与模糊性
subs.desc_en: Self-tracking reconsidered: open interpretation, ambiguity, reflection rather than measurement.
subs.desc_zh: 重新思考自我追踪：开放诠释、模糊性，重在反思而非测量。

fields.desc_en: The moving body in dance, performance, sport, play and art, and the computing built around it.
fields.desc_zh: 舞蹈、表演、运动、游戏与艺术中运动的身体，以及围绕它构建的计算。

subs.desc_en: Choreography, sensing and projection with and for dancers.
subs.desc_zh: 与舞者一起、为舞者而做的编舞、传感与投影。

subs.desc_en: Modelling movement quality: Laban effort, MOCO, interactive machine learning for movement.
subs.desc_zh: 对动作质感建模：Laban 力效、MOCO、面向动作的交互式机器学习。

subs.desc_en: Exertion games, body-centric play, physical training and sport.
subs.desc_zh: 运动型游戏、以身体为中心的玩、体能训练与体育。

subs.desc_en: Somatic performance, the singing body, opera with machines.
subs.desc_zh: 身体性表演、歌唱的身体、与机器同台的歌剧。

subs.desc_en: Art that works directly on the visitor's senses and body: Lygia Clark, Rebecca Horn, Char Davies.
subs.desc_zh: 直接作用于观众感官与身体的艺术：Lygia Clark、Rebecca Horn、Char Davies。

fields.zh: 亲密、女性主义与酷儿身体
fields.desc_en: Designing for bodies that design has ignored or made taboo: menstruation, pleasure, fertility, menopause, queer and trans bodies.
fields.desc_zh: 为设计长期忽视或视为禁忌的身体而设计：月经、愉悦、生育、更年期、酷儿与跨性别身体。

subs.desc_en: Touching and being in touch with the menstruating body.
subs.desc_zh: 触碰并贴近来月经的身体。

subs.desc_en: Pleasure, intimacy and sexual wellbeing as design topics.
subs.desc_zh: 把愉悦、亲密与性健康作为设计主题。

subs.zh: 女性主义人机交互与女性健康
subs.desc_en: Pelvic floor, fertility, pregnancy and the politics of tracking women's bodies.
subs.desc_zh: 盆底、生育、怀孕，以及追踪女性身体的政治。

subs.zh: 更年期、衰老与生命转折
subs.desc_en: Bodies changing over a life: menopause, ageing, illness.
subs.desc_zh: 一生中变化的身体：更年期、衰老、疾病。

subs.desc_en: Soma design with and for queer, trans and non-normative bodies.
subs.desc_zh: 与酷儿、跨性别及非规范身体一起、为他们而做的身体设计。

fields.desc_en: Somatic approaches to pain, rehabilitation, stress and mental health, where feeling better starts from feeling more.
fields.desc_zh: 面向疼痛、康复、压力与心理健康的身体取向：感觉更好，始于感觉更多。

subs.desc_en: Movement confidence, pain and physical rehabilitation.
subs.desc_zh: 动作信心、疼痛与身体康复。

subs.desc_en: Biofeedback, breath and body awareness for stress and mental health.
subs.desc_zh: 借助生物反馈、呼吸与身体觉察应对压力、改善心理健康。

subs.zh: 神经多样性与运动障碍
subs.desc_en: Parkinson's, stroke, autism, sensory differences.
subs.desc_zh: 帕金森、中风、自闭症与感官差异。

subs.desc_en: Bodies in care: older adults, caregivers, touch in care.
subs.desc_zh: 处在照护关系中的身体：老年人、照护者、照护中的触碰。

fields.desc_en: Intercorporeality: feeling each other's bodies through mediated touch, shared breath and heartbeat, and collective movement.
fields.desc_zh: 身体间性：通过中介的触碰、共享的呼吸与心跳，以及集体动作，感受彼此的身体。

subs.desc_en: Touch at a distance, hugs, holding hands through technology.
subs.desc_zh: 远距离的触碰、拥抱，以技术牵手。

subs.zh: 共享的呼吸、心跳与同步
subs.desc_en: Sharing biosignals and falling into rhythm with others.
subs.desc_zh: 分享生物信号，与他人进入同一节律。

subs.zh: 集体与参与式的身体经验
subs.desc_en: Groups moving, breathing and sensing together.
subs.desc_zh: 一群人一起运动、呼吸与感受。

fields.zh: 身体与机器、AI 与扩展现实
fields.desc_en: Soma design meets drones, robots, machine learning, virtual bodies and more-than-human others.
fields.desc_zh: 身体设计遇上无人机、机器人、机器学习、虚拟身体与超越人类的他者。

subs.zh: 身体美学的机器人与无人机
subs.desc_en: Drone Chi, soft and inflatable robots, robots felt through the body.
subs.desc_zh: Drone Chi、软体与充气机器人、用身体去感受的机器人。

subs.en: Soma Design with AI & Machine Learning
subs.zh: 与 AI 和机器学习的身体设计
subs.desc_en: Machine learning as a somatic material; AI that listens to the body.
subs.desc_zh: 把机器学习当作身体材料；聆听身体的 AI。

subs.desc_en: Body ownership, embodiment swaps, breath- and biosignal-driven VR/AR.
subs.desc_zh: 身体拥有感、身体互换、由呼吸与生物信号驱动的 VR/AR。

subs.desc_en: Feeling with plants, animals, weather and ecosystems.
subs.desc_zh: 与植物、动物、天气和生态系统一同感受。

modalities: 电刺激（肌肉电刺激、前庭电刺激）
多出来的肢体与身体延伸

collections.en: Designing with the Body (Höök, MIT Press 2018)
collections.desc_en: Works and methods discussed in Kristina Höök's book that defined soma design.
collections.desc_zh: Kristina Höök 奠定身体设计的专著中讨论的作品与方法。

collections.en: Embracing First-Person Perspectives in Soma-Based Design (2018)
collections.zh: 《在身体设计中拥抱第一人称视角》（2018）
collections.desc_en: The 22-author paper (Höök et al., Informatics 2018) gathering designers' first-person soma design cases.
collections.desc_zh: Höök 等 22 位作者（Informatics 2018）汇集设计师第一人称身体设计案例的论文。

collections.zh: ACM CHI 人机交互大会
collections.desc_en: Soma design papers at the ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems.
collections.desc_zh: 发表于 ACM CHI 人机交互大会的身体设计论文。

collections.zh: ACM DIS 交互系统设计会议
collections.desc_en: Papers at ACM Designing Interactive Systems.
collections.desc_zh: 发表于 ACM DIS 交互系统设计会议的论文。

collections.zh: ACM TEI 有形、嵌入与具身交互会议
collections.desc_en: Papers and works at Tangible, Embedded and Embodied Interaction.
collections.desc_zh: 发表于 TEI 有形、嵌入与具身交互会议的论文与作品。

collections.desc_en: Papers and works at the International Conference on Movement and Computing.
collections.desc_zh: 发表于国际运动与计算会议（MOCO）的论文与作品。

collections.zh: NIME 新音乐表达界面会议
collections.desc_en: Works at New Interfaces for Musical Expression.
collections.desc_zh: 发表于 NIME 新音乐表达界面会议的作品。

lenses: Soma as one living whole: non-dualist design, thinking through the felt body.
身体是一个活的整体：非二元的设计，用被感受的身体思考。
Tools, limbs and senses the body incorporates as its own, and what stays the same soma.
身体纳为己有的工具、肢体与感官，以及其中不变的那个身体。
The designer's and user's own felt experience as knowledge.
设计者与使用者的亲身感受即是知识。
Slowing down, turning inward, cultivating somatic sensitivity.
慢下来、向内转、培养身体的感受力。
Making the habitual body strange so it can be felt again.
让习以为常的身体变得陌生，从而再次被感受到。
Emotion as embodied, felt and co-produced between body and system.
情绪是具身的、被感受的，在身体与系统之间被共同产生。
Actuation onto the body: heat, pressure, vibration, shape.
作用于身体的执行：热、压力、振动、形状。
Bodies sensing and resonating with other bodies.
身体感受他人的身体，并与之共振。
Movement quality, gesture and choreography as meaning.
动作质感、手势与编舞承载意义。
Biosignals and tracking, read as open and ambiguous rather than as truth.
把生物信号和追踪数据读作开放、模糊的，而不是真相。
Wellbeing, rehabilitation and caring for bodies.
安适、康复与对身体的照护。
快乐、感官享受、玩性与身体的发力。
Whose bodies, which norms: feminist, queer, disability and cultural perspectives.
谁的身体、什么规范：女性主义、酷儿、残障与文化视角。
Soma extended to machines, other species and environments.
把身体延伸到机器、其他物种与环境。

org_themes: 女性主义与酷儿人机交互
